title: Certificates that do not set rotationPolicy start rotating their private key on every renewal

detection.reason: the agent writes this boolean on every Certificate, so a clean result means every Certificate sets the policy explicitly

quote: We have changed the default value of `Certificate.Spec.PrivateKey.RotationPolicy` from `Never` to `Always`.
remediation: Set `privateKey.rotationPolicy: Never` explicitly on any Certificate that must keep its key across renewals (anything with a pinned public key, a registered fingerprint, or a key distributed out of band). Otherwise accept the new default, which is the more secure one.
verifyCommand: kubectl get certificates -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.privateKey.rotationPolicy == null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row starts re-keying on every renewal after the upgrade

title: Certificates that do not set revisionHistoryLimit keep only the latest CertificateRequest

detection.reason: the agent writes this boolean on every Certificate, so a clean result means every Certificate sets the limit explicitly

quote: We have changed the default value of `Certificate.Spec.RevisionHistoryLimit` from `nil` to `1`.
remediation: Set `revisionHistoryLimit` explicitly on Certificates whose older CertificateRequests you audit or keep for evidence — after the upgrade all but the newest revision is garbage-collected.
verifyCommand: kubectl get certificates -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.revisionHistoryLimit == null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row loses every CertificateRequest revision but the newest
coversNotes: The default value of `Certificate.Spec.RevisionHistoryLimit` is now `1`

title: HTTP-01 challenge Ingresses switch to PathType Exact — older ingress-nginx rejects them

detection.reason: whether a solver uses an Ingress is projected; which controller serves that class, and its version, is not a fact of the issuer — the command settles it

quote: This change is incompatible with certain versions and configurations of the `ingress-nginx` Ingress controller.
remediation: If those solvers are served by ingress-nginx below v1.12.6 / v1.13.2 with `strict-validate-path-type` on, upgrade ingress-nginx, disable that option, or set the `ACMEHTTP01IngressPathTypeExact: false` feature gate on cert-manager.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | .spec.template.spec.containers[].image | select(test("ingress-nginx/controller"))' | sort -u  # a controller older than v1.12.6 / v1.13.2 rejects the Exact challenge path when strict-validate-path-type is on (its default since 1.12.0); NO rows = no ingress-nginx
